chains.name: Sempiternity
chains.description: Every time an allied unit casts the Ultimate, Vanilla gains a 5% increase in Max HP. This effect can stack up to 4 times.

chains.name: Time Dilation
chains.description: Vanilla gains 1 additional M-Value every time she takes damage, and the maximum M-Value she can gain per second increases by 5. In [Corruption State], she gains 2 M-Value per second.

chains.name: Energy Overflowing
chains.description: At the start of the battle, Vanilla gains 25 M-Value.

buffs.description:
[Potential Charge]: Vanilla charges up, restoring 4% Max HP per second and switching her Ultimate to [Kinetic Release] for 10 seconds. If [Kinetic Release] is not used within this period, her Ultimate is switched back to [Potential Charge] and she then gains 10 energy.
[Kinetic Release]: Vanilla unleashes a heavy punch, dealing (Max HP *?%) Physical Damage and 1 Core Damage to all enemies within the 3x3 square in front. Meanwhile, her Ultimate is switched to [Potential Charge].
[Corruption State]: [Potential Charge] now restores 8% Max HP per second and [Kinetic Release] now deals ?% damage and 1 additional Core Damage.
